017package org.apache.juneau.rest.client.jetty;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020
021import org.eclipse.jetty.client.*;
022
023/**
024 * Fluent builder for {@link JettyHttpTransport}.
025 *
026 * <p>
027 * Obtain an instance via {@link JettyHttpTransport#builder()}.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack
031 * ({@code org.apache.juneau.marshall.ng.*}).
032 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
033 * (and possibly earlier).
034 *
035 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
036 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/NextGenRestClient">juneau-ng REST client</a>
037 * </ul>
038 *
039 * @since 9.2.1
040 */
041@SuppressWarnings({
042   "resource" // Builder methods return Closeables owned by the caller; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
043})
044public final class JettyHttpTransportBuilder {
045
046   HttpClient httpClient;
047   long responseTimeoutMs = 30_000;
048
049   JettyHttpTransportBuilder() {}
050
051   /**
052    * Sets the underlying {@link HttpClient} to use.
053    *
054    * <p>
055    * If not set, a default client is created via {@code new HttpClient()}.
056    *
057    * <p>
058    * If the provided client has not been started, {@link JettyHttpTransport} will start it automatically.
059    * When {@link JettyHttpTransport#close()} is called, the client will be stopped.
060    *
061    * @param value The client to use. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
062    * @return This object.
063    */
064   public JettyHttpTransportBuilder httpClient(HttpClient value) {
065      httpClient = assertArgNotNull("value", value);
066      return this;
067   }
068
069   /**
070    * Sets the maximum time to wait for the response headers to arrive after the request is sent.
071    *
072    * <p>
073    * This timeout covers the time from when the request is fully sent until the first response line and headers
074    * are received.  It does not limit how long the response body may take to stream.
075    * Defaults to {@code 30_000} ms (30 seconds).
076    *
077    * @param value The timeout in milliseconds. Use {@code 0} or a negative value to wait indefinitely.
078    * @return This object.
079    */
080   public JettyHttpTransportBuilder responseTimeoutMs(long value) {
081      responseTimeoutMs = value;
082      return this;
083   }
084
085   /**
086    * Builds and returns the {@link JettyHttpTransport}.
087    *
088    * @return A new instance. Never <jk>null</jk>.
089    * @throws Exception If the Jetty {@link HttpClient} cannot be started.
090    */
091   public JettyHttpTransport build() throws Exception {
092      return new JettyHttpTransport(this);
093   }
094}
